name: email-list-checker
title: Email List Checker: Valid, Disposable & Dead Emails
description: Clean your email list in bulk. For every address: is it written correctly, does the domain exist, can it receive mail, is it a throwaway address, a free inbox or a role inbox like info@, and is the sender setup (SPF, DMARC) in place. Typo fixes included. Paste thousands at once. No API key needed.
